contract_templates.title: The Salt Convoy
contract_templates.public_objective: Escort a salt merchant caravan from Thornhaven to Millbrook village
contract_templates.hidden_complication: The merchant is actually transporting cult members disguised as guards
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Defend caravan against 2 ambushes on route
contract_templates.success_result: Merchant pays full amount plus bonus. Gain merchant guild reputation.
contract_templates.failure_result: Caravan destroyed. Merchant guild contract ban for 30 days.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial cargo saved. Reduced payment. No reputation gain.

contract_templates.title: The Greenglass Patrol
contract_templates.public_objective: Patrol the Greenglass road for 7 days, eliminating bandit threats
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Bandits are actually former miners driven to desperation by merchant price-fixing
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Engage and eliminate 4-6 bandit groups
contract_templates.success_result: Road safe. Council grants patrol bonus and salvage rights.
contract_templates.failure_result: Bandits grow bolder. Council contract access reduced.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Some bandits eliminated. Road partially safe.

contract_templates.title: The Blacktide Boar Hunt
contract_templates.public_objective: Eliminate the bandit leader known as Blacktide Vex
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Blacktide is actually a deserter from the noble's own militia
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track to hidden camp, defeat bodyguards, kill/capture leader
contract_templates.success_result: Noble pays bounty. Area secured. Minor militia desertion scandal suppressed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Blacktide escapes. Noble contract access lost.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Bodyguards dead, Blacktide wounded and escaped but wounded.

contract_templates.title: The Thornwood Wyrm
contract_templates.public_objective: Slay the wyrm terrorizing travelers near Thornwood
contract_templates.hidden_complication: The wyrm is actually a transformed human - a cursed noble seeking death
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Navigate to lair, survive wyrm encounter, slay or free the creature
contract_templates.success_result: Wyrm slain. Council grants reward and rare monster parts.
contract_templates.failure_result: Wyrm continues attacks. Council posts higher bounty.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Wyrm driven off but not killed. Reduced reward.

contract_templates.title: The Crimson Ledger
contract_templates.public_objective: Capture the accountant Vex Coldthumb - alive, preferably
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Vex has evidence of bounty guild corruption that could expose the guild
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track Vex to hideout. Can capture alive (+50% reward) or kill.
contract_templates.success_result: Vex captured. Full bounty paid. Guild pleased.
contract_templates.failure_result: Vex escapes or dies. Bounty lost. Possible evidence exposure.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Vex killed but evidence destroyed. Partial bounty.

contract_templates.title: The Drowned Provision
contract_templates.public_objective: Find and recover the supply wagon lost on the Mire Road
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Wagon was deliberately sunk to collect insurance - driver alive and hiding
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Locate wagon in swamp, retrieve cargo, deal with driver or bandits
contract_templates.success_result: Wagon and cargo recovered. Full payment plus salvage bonus.
contract_templates.failure_result: Wagon remains lost. Merchant guild suspicious.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial cargo recovered. Driver found but wagon destroyed.

contract_templates.title: The Greenglass Uprising
contract_templates.public_objective: End the riot at Greenglass market square before更多人 is killed
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Riot is orchestrated by a rival faction trying to topple the council
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Disperse rioters with minimal casualties. Protect council members.
contract_templates.success_result: Riot dispersed. Council grateful. Salvage rights granted.
contract_templates.failure_result: Council members injured. Settlement destabilizes.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Riot suppressed but underlying issues remain.

contract_templates.title: The Fever Cure
contract_templates.public_objective: Urgent delivery of medicine to plague-stricken Dusthallow
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Plague is actually caused by contaminated water supply controlled by a rival faction
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Deliver medicine before plague kills 20+ population. May face route ambush.
contract_templates.success_result: Medicine delivered. Plague contained. Healer guild highly pleased.
contract_templates.failure_result: Plague spreads. Settlement population -30. Healer guild hostile.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial medicine delivered. Plague slowed but continues.

contract_templates.title: The Last Defense of Millbrook
contract_templates.public_objective: Defend Millbrook against impending raider assault
contract_templates.hidden_complication: One council member is secretly coordinating with raiders for personal gain
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Fortify positions, survive 2-wave assault, protect key buildings.
contract_templates.success_result: Raiders repelled. Settlement secure. Council grants land deed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Settlement sacked. Population -50. Settlement may be abandoned.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Raiders driven off but settlement damaged.

contract_templates.title: The Ashen Accord
contract_templates.public_objective: Destroy the Ironblood trading company's main warehouse
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Warehouse contains evidence clearing an innocent party of smuggling charges
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Infiltrate, plant evidence or destroy goods, escape undetected.
contract_templates.success_result: Warehouse destroyed. Patron pleased. Blackmail material obtained.
contract_templates.failure_result: Caught. Multiple faction hostilities triggered.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial destruction. Cover partially blown.

contract_templates.title: The Hollow Mill
contract_templates.public_objective: Investigate disappearances in the Millhaven region
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Disappearances caused by a sleeping demon awakened by cult rituals
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Interview witnesses, track disappearances, confront true source.
contract_templates.success_result: Investigation complete. Cult exposed. Demon contained or destroyed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Disappearances continue. Cult grows stronger.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Cult partially exposed. Demon remains active but weakened.

contract_templates.title: The Iron Militia
contract_templates.public_objective: Train Millbrook's militia for 14 days
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Militia captain is actually a traitor planning coup
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Improve militia技能 and discipline. Uncover traitor if possible.
contract_templates.success_result: Militia trained and loyal. Town security permanently improved.
contract_templates.failure_result: Militia mutinies. Traitor takes power. Council control lost.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Militia partially trained. Traitor remains hidden.

contract_templates.title: The Widow's Road
contract_templates.public_objective: Escort a widow and her children to her new home in Crossfield
contract_templates.hidden_complication: The widow is actually fleeing an abusive noble who now hunts her
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Protect family from noble's agents. May face legal harassment.
contract_templates.success_result: Family safe. Hidden reward in gratitude. Noble embarrassed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Family captured. Reputation damage. Legal consequences.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Family escapes but without possessions.

contract_templates.title: The River Reavers
contract_templates.public_objective: Eliminate the river pirates demanding toll on the Veridian
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Pirates are actually former river patrol guards unpaid by corrupt officials
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track pirates to river hideout. Destroy their boats and crew.
contract_templates.success_result: Pirates eliminated. River tolls resume. Trade guild pleased.
contract_templates.failure_result: Pirates continue. Trade routes disrupted.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Pirates scattered but not destroyed.

contract_templates.title: The Bleeding Oak
contract_templates.public_objective: Kill or cure the corrupted treant known as the Bleeding Oak
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Corruption source is a hidden cult draining the treant's essence
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Reach ancient grove, confront treant, find and destroy corruption source.
contract_templates.success_result: Treant saved or slain with dignity. Ancient grove restored.
contract_templates.failure_result: Treant fully corrupted. Grove lost. Druids hostile.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Treant destroyed but corruption source escapes.

contract_templates.title: The Broken Coin
contract_templates.public_objective: Capture the merchant who fled with the consortium's investment
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Merchant has evidence of consortium's own illegal pricing schemes
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track merchant to hiding. Capture alive for full bounty.
contract_templates.success_result: Merchant captured. Consortium pleased. Evidence suppressed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Merchant disappears. Evidence may surface.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Merchant killed. Evidence destroyed. Partial payment.

contract_templates.title: The Sunken Treasury
contract_templates.public_objective: Recover noble house treasury gold lost in a river crossing
contract_templates.hidden_complication: River creatures now guard the gold and have been using it to build a nest
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Dive/retrieve gold from river. Deal with river creature nest.
contract_templates.success_result: Gold recovered. Noble grants bonus and minor land deed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Gold lost. Noble contract access lost.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial gold recovered. River creatures remain.

contract_templates.title: The Crossfield Crisis
contract_templates.public_objective: Restore order in Crossfield after food riot turns violent
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Food shortage caused by lord's own grain hoarding for profit
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Disperse riot. Protect granary. Minimum casualties required.
contract_templates.success_result: Order restored. Lord grateful but peasants remember.
contract_templates.failure_result: Rioters take granary. Lord loses control of settlement.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Riot suppressed but resentment remains.

contract_templates.title: The Gray Lotus
contract_templates.public_objective: Deliver rare Gray Lotus medicine to the quarantined village of Mirehollow
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Quarantine enforced by cult to spread their disease for dark ritual
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Bypass quarantine. Deliver medicine. Expose cult if discovered.
contract_templates.success_result: Quarantine lifted. Village saved. Cult exposed and scattered.
contract_templates.failure_result: Cult completes ritual. Village becomes cult stronghold.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Medicine delivered but cult escapes with ritual components.

contract_templates.title: The Siege of Fort Ironward
contract_templates.public_objective: Defend Fort Ironward against besieging forces
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Inside man will open gate at midnight - prevent or exploit
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Survive siege. Find traitor. Lead counterattack.
contract_templates.success_result: Siege broken. Fort secure. Inside man exposed.
contract_templates.failure_result: Fort falls. Military order expelled from region.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Siege broken but fort damaged. Traitor escapes.

contract_templates.title: The Silenced Archive
contract_templates.public_objective: Burn the archives containing intelligence on your patron's operations
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Archives also contain evidence of spy network's own crimes
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Infiltrate archive building. Destroy specific section. Minimize casualties.
contract_templates.success_result: Archives destroyed. Patron pleased. Evidence of your patron's crimes also gone.
contract_templates.failure_result: Caught and executed. Spy network exposed.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial destruction. Evidence of both sides remains.

contract_templates.title: The Vanishing of Brindlemark
contract_templates.public_objective: Find the merchant Corin Brindlemark who vanished en route to market
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Corin witnessed a crime and is being hidden by witnesses
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track route. Interview villagers. Find witnesses. Extract truth.
contract_templates.success_result: Corin found alive. Truth revealed. Family grateful.
contract_templates.failure_result: Corin never found. Family devastated.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Corin found dead. Truth partially revealed.

contract_templates.title: The Forge's Edge
contract_templates.public_objective: Train the settlement's craftsmen in militia duties for defense
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Guild master plans to use trained militia for guild uprising
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Improve militia combat技能. Decide whether to expose guild plan.
contract_templates.success_result: Militia trained. Guild master reveals plan - support or expose?
contract_templates.failure_result: Training fails. Militia discipline worse than before.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Militia partially trained. Guild plan hidden.

contract_templates.title: The Merchant's Guard
contract_templates.public_objective: Premium escort of luxury goods through dangerous territory
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Goods include illegal relics that another faction wants seized
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Deliver cargo intact. Deal with faction interceptors.
contract_templates.success_result: Cargo delivered. Premium payment. But faction hostile.
contract_templates.failure_result: Cargo seized. Faction hostile. Merchant relationship damaged.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial cargo delivered. Relics lost.

contract_templates.title: The Thornwatch Eradication
contract_templates.public_objective: Destroy the bandit stronghold threatening Thornwatch settlements
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Bandit leader is former soldier framed for war crimes he didn't commit
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Storm stronghold. Kill/convert leader. Eliminate bandit threat.
contract_templates.success_result: Stronghold destroyed. Settlers safe. But former soldier's truth remains hidden.
contract_templates.failure_result: Bandits grow stronger. Settlements abandoned.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Stronghold damaged. Bandits scatter temporarily.

contract_templates.title: The Mossheart Matriarch
contract_templates.public_objective: Slay or relocate the elder troll living in Mossheart Cave
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Troll is protecting a hidden spring that supplies clean water to three villages
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Deal with troll. Ensure water supply maintained. Find alternative if troll killed.
contract_templates.success_result: Solution found - troll relocated or spring protected. Druids pleased.
contract_templates.failure_result: Troll killed but spring polluted. Villages lose water.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Troll driven off but returns. Water supply uncertain.

contract_templates.title: The Fugitive's Choice
contract_templates.public_objective: Capture the refugee who fled your patron's rival nation
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Refugee is actually innocent of crimes accused and has evidence of patron's crimes
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Capture refugee. Discover truth. Choose who to serve.
contract_templates.success_result: Refugee captured. Patron pleased. But your company marked.
contract_templates.failure_result: Refugee escapes with evidence. Your crimes recorded.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Refugee killed. Evidence destroyed. Bounty paid but reputation damaged.

contract_templates.title: The Graveyard Watch
contract_templates.public_objective: Recover the hearse stolen from the Greenglass cemetery
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Necromancer is using the hearse to transport corpses for flesh golem creation
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Track hearse to hideout. Destroy necromancer operation. Recover hearse.
contract_templates.success_result: Necromancer stopped. Hearse recovered. Undead threat eliminated.
contract_templates.failure_result: Necromancer completes golem army. Settlement threatened.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Hearse recovered but necromancer escaped.

contract_templates.title: The Peasant's Vengeance
contract_templates.public_objective: Collect overdue rents and suppress any resistance
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Rents are actually being collected by corrupt middleman, not the landlord
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Collect rents. Expose or work with corrupt middleman. Manage peasants.
contract_templates.success_result: Rents collected. Middleman exposed. Landlord may reward or punish peasants.
contract_templates.failure_result: Peasants revolt. Settlement abandoned. Landlord hostile.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Partial rents collected. Situation unchanged.

contract_templates.title: The Conclave's Plea
contract_templates.public_objective: Deliver blessed medicine to the plague-stricken shrine of the Silver Dawn
contract_templates.hidden_complication: Plague is divine punishment for heresy - blessing may not cure
contract_templates.tactical_objective: Deliver medicine. Investigate plague cause. Decide whether to reveal heresy.
contract_templates.success_result: Plague identified as divine punishment. Shrine purified through repentance.
contract_templates.failure_result: Plague spreads. Shrine destroyed. Conclave faith shaken.
contract_templates.partial_success_result: Medicine delivered but plague source remains.
